jeremie frimpong [...] Liverpool are without Dominik Szoboszlai and Jeremie Frimpong for the Champions League clash against Villarreal, but Cody Gakpo could start.

The Reds endured a frustrating trip to Brentford on Saturday despite picking up a turnaround 2-1 victory, with both Szoboszlai and Frimpong forced off with injuries.

Speaking ahead of the Villarreal match, Iraola confirmed the pair will both miss tonight’s fixture, with Frimpong facing several weeks out but Szoboszlai’s issue deemed less serious. [...] He could take the place of Victor Munoz on the flank, completing a front four with Florian Wirtz, Bradley Barcola and Alexander Isak

Ronald Araujo spoke alongside Iraola at the pre-match press conference, suggesting he is in line to start. Having only played 45 minutes last time out, he should be fit and fresh.

He is likely to at right-back as part of an unchanged back four, though there may be scope for Kostas Tsimikas to come in at left-back.

data.title: Liverpool vs Villarreal Predictions, Picks & Odds - 20/10/2026
data.content: Fitness concerns cloud Liverpool's attacking options, with Cody Gakpo and Alexander Isak being monitored day-to-day and Dominik Szoboszlai managing tightness. That said, Anfield's atmosphere under the floodlights tends to elevate whoever takes the pitch. Villarreal will also be without Tajon Buchanan due to a muscular injury. The balance of quality, venue advantage, and Villarreal's wretched continental streak all point towards a Liverpool victory. [...] Villarreal arrive on Merseyside in dire European form, winless across their last twelve Champions League outings and on a seven-match losing streak that threatens an unwanted record for a Spanish club. Currently 21st in the standings, they occupy an unseeded play-off berth but risk slipping further. A narrow 1-0 loss to Real Madrid, despite controlling possession, underlined their competitive spirit, yet Tajon Buchanan's hamstring injury adds to their difficulties on the road. [...] Liverpool sit 14th in the Champions League league stage and will be eager to consolidate their seeded knockout play-off position. Andoni Iraola's side have won three of their last five home matches, though a jarring 3-0 defeat to Manchester City in the Premier League last time out at Anfield will have dented confidence. Fitness concerns linger around Cody Gakpo, Alexander Isak, and Dominik Szoboszlai, all of whom are being monitored ahead of kickoff.
